text:
Hi everyone,
My wife received her A5 visa/status from PIBA about two weeks ago. Since then, I've been trying to move her from Maccabi Welcome to the regular Maccabi programme (Maccabi Sheli).

I couldn't do it over the phone, so I went to a Maccabi branch in Tel Aviv. They told me there's an issue with her status in the system and that I need to contact Bituach Leumi.

Has anyone been through this process? Is that the correct next step? Do I just need to wait a bit longer for her new status to update in their systems? Also, is she eligible to join Maccabi Sheli now, or does she need to remain on Maccabi Welcome?

Thanks in advance for any advice!
